falt.contentDescription: This advertisement, run by the Facebook page "Bustatio-busto" (page ID 262424923617670), reproduces our copyrighted advertising material without authorisation. The ad's video is a re-upload of our own ad films "IBC_PD_4_H2", "IBC_PD_4_H1" (published by us on 9 September 2026, before this ad started running on 25 September 2026), with the same edit and our Swedish on-screen text at the same timestamps; the advertiser has added its own watermark. 3 still frames from different scenes of the reported video (at 0:00, 0:04, 0:05) are identical to frames of our films, including our on-screen text (perceptual-hash distance 0, 0, 0/64). Our original ads are public in Meta's Ad Library: "IBC_PD_4_H1" https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=959107410554528, "IBC_PD_4_H2" https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=28341728188789408. According to the Ad Library it has reached approximately 280 people in the EU. It copies our ads "IBC_PD_4_H2", "IBC_PD_4_H1" for the product "IBC-tanköverdrag 1000 L – Stoppar Alger & UV", which our page ran before this ad appeared. This is report 5 of 6 concerning ads from the same advertiser; each ad is reported separately.
